availability.custom_hours_hint: Off: follows the company working hours.

FLAT.label: Flat price
FLAT.description: One fixed price for the whole job.

PER_UNIT.label: Per item
PER_UNIT.description: Price × number of items (tanks, windows, curtains).

PER_SEAT.label: Per seat
PER_SEAT.description: Sofas and chairs: price × seats, with a minimum.

PER_VARIANT.label: By size or type
PER_VARIANT.description: Customer picks a size (5×6, 6×6) with its own price.

PER_AREA.label: Per square metre
PER_AREA.description: Tiered m² rates for offices and post-construction.

INSPECTION_REQUIRED.label: Quote after inspection
INSPECTION_REQUIRED.description: A staff visit sets the price. Booking goes to review.
INSPECTION_REQUIRED.editor_hint: The customer can book, but no price is charged until your team inspects and sends a quote.

CUSTOM_QUOTE.label: Custom quote
CUSTOM_QUOTE.description: Large or unusual jobs priced by hand.
CUSTOM_QUOTE.editor_hint: Requests arrive in the review queue; you send the price manually.

catalog.services_subtitle: What customers can book, and what each job costs.
catalog.new_service_subtitle: Pick how it is priced first; the form shows only what that model needs.
catalog.created: {{name}} created. Customers can book it now.
catalog.saved: {{name}} saved. New quotes use the new price.
catalog.archive_body: Customers can no longer book it. Existing tickets keep their prices. You cannot undo this from the app.
catalog.empty_body: Add the services you offer with their prices. Customers see exactly these on your booking page.
catalog.no_match_body: Try different words or clear the filters.
catalog.addons_hint: Optional extras the customer can add to this service (stain treatment, odour removal…).

field.recurrence_hint: e.g. 90 for sofas, 30 for fumigation. Leave empty for none.

rule.min_charge_hint: Small jobs are rounded up to this amount.
rule.tier_mode_hint: Bracket: the whole area is charged at the rate of the tier it falls in. Marginal: each tier charges only its own slice.
rule.tiers_hint: From smallest to largest. Leave the last 'up to' empty for 'and above'.
rule.ranges_hint: Customers rarely know exact m². Offer ranges; the quote uses the assumed size and is marked as an estimate.
rule.from_price_hint: Optional. Helps customers decide before the visit.
